items.q: Where does most innovation come from, says Rory Sutherland?
items.a: **Answering a different question**, not a better answer to the same one.
What it feels like to **wait for a taxi**, and how you pay.

items.q: Why did Rory's cracked basin stay broken for 18 months?
items.a: Not the money but the **friction** of getting it done.
Technology starts **optional** (self-checkout) and becomes **mandatory** once it saves the company money.

items.q: What does an unusually fast rollout tell you?
items.a: There is usually a **hidden revenue reason**, like parking apps earning **70% more**.

items.q: What makes 'Brunch, where dogs are always welcome' a great sign?
items.a: It **answers the customer's two questions** in one line.

items.q: Why offer phone booking as well as an app?
items.a: Be **available in every buying situation**; offering both sells more.
Find what competitors **overlook or can't do**, instead of copying their metrics.
